Place batch 206: revised K215 proof-simplification packet, retire its archive

K215_Proof_Simplification_2026-10-21 (2).zip (arrival 53269bcab1) differs from batch 205's archive of the same name: coq/ proves symmetry for the actual offset checker and the compact/original certificate equality (Coq 8.18, coqchk), plain_source/ checks the ordinary zero-offset source equivalence in Lean (70 modules), formal_cm215/ transports CM215 to KDense215.machine215. All its tables are already in the repository. Placed whole and byte-identical as k225-formal/verification/k215/simplification/proposals/k215-simplification-2/ (logs stay out by the ignore rules), indexed in proposals/README.md; nothing rerun; the queue is clear.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Place batch 205: six K215 proof-simplification packets, retire 6 archives

The six packets of a6b3a30011 propose shorter K215 proofs. Each is placed
whole and byte-identical under k225-formal/verification/k215/simplification/
proposals/ (logs, TeX auxiliaries and checksum lists stay out by the ignore
rules), omitting only copies of repository files (zfc-k215-transport/
reference/, fm215-compression machine/inherited_notices/ and machine/tables/).
proposals/README.md indexes them with their status against main:
- realized: the single Lean source certificate (RMOffsetBisim.OBisim.symm);
- open: the single-certificate Rocq source proof with a compact path codec
  (zfc215-simplification/source_proof/Source215Simple.v, Coq 8.18), the
  trailing-zero quotient of the Lean certificate (2,240 -> 1,426,
  k215-simplification), the calibration round-trip patch (structural), and
  shared decoder contexts for KSites215 (fm215-compression, structural);
- CM215 <-> K215 and M124 <-> K215 transport proofs (positive stuttering),
  compiled standalone, are formal endpoints for those alternatives once
  their adapters compile.

The only new 215-state table, FM215, differs from batch 204's M124 in one
row (127/1 -> 109 instead of 59), so it was not placed as an alternative.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Place batch 204: six unique 215-state alternatives, retire 9 archives

Discard essential duplicates, preserve unique alternatives (direction for
these batches). All 578 incoming .tm tables were put in rooted breadth-first
canonical form and compared with every repository table and with each other.

Placed as delivered (byte-identical, nothing rerun) under
candidate-k215/alternatives/, each with an INTAKE.md:
- dr215 (DR215_research, 2a11b6d29f): direct transfer + rho6 permutation,
  repaired strong selector. late_comparison/ (ZC215 copies) omitted.
- forced-transfer (FT215_Forced_Transfer, 6101f25c72): S;W(0);S;W(1);...
  scheduler, conservative debt seven. cache216/, composite216/ omitted.
- zero-credit (ZC215_Research, a10b2c302c): DROP 0 / NIP 1 tags and
  exhaustive enumeration; NIP->DROP lowering injects pops into earlier pushes,
  so no AX stack credit is needed. reference/ (parent copies) omitted.
- gc215 (ZFC_GC215, dfe1f22bdf): the AX tag as generalization binder, paid
  for by a conditional decoder merge. reference/ (corpus, gc216) omitted.
- context-returns (ZFC_K215_Context_Transfers, b6fb232916): history-dependent
  decoder returns; k215-context and the principal k215-shallow (depth 46).
  upstream/ (K215 copies) omitted.
- gc-zc215 (Proof_Simplification_and_GC-ZC215, 05d063acef): gc215 combined
  with zero-credit enumeration; zc215 copies and the inert 216 allocation
  omitted. Its proof_refactor/ goes to k225-formal/verification/k215/
  simplification/proposal-2026-10-21/ with an INTAKE.md recording which
  proposals main already realizes (Lean OBisim.symm) and which are open
  (Rocq mirror check, compact Rocq certificate).

Retired without placement:
- ZFC_ST215_Rho6_and_New_Routes (b872b34ff4): the same table as dr215.
- NW215_counter_stack (dfe1f22bdf): K215's source conjugated by the register
  permutation 0 <-> 2, a renaming of registers.
- SB215_ZFC (2a11b6d29f): refuted. The correction review shipped in
  gc-zc215/correction/ shows that in SB215 and SB215-AB the return after AX
  reaches selector ordinal 23, not the scheduler, so the NIP test halts on
  cache 1 from the blank tape.

Adds six index rows and the batch-204 queue entry. No numbered Sources, no
write report; the queue is clear.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
